svg.title: Three decisions on one bar of a Demucs-separated bass stem
svg.desc: The input waveform is aligned to sixteen cells showing measured RMS and onset scores. Active runs at cells 0 through 6, 8 through 9, and 13 through 15 are split into four D1 notes and A1, B1, C sharp 2. Cell 4's decay tail remains active. Regions are outlined before pitch voting, followed by the measured voiced frame pitches and probabilities and the resulting notes.

g.text: Primrose’s “Ring” · Demucs bass stem · bar 11 · 105 BPM
Gray columns are inactive. Orange marks accepted starts.
Each dot and probability bar is one voiced frame. Unvoiced frames do not vote.
